comparison_baseline_submission: 21d37ea8 (i34-9, PR827 square + fused-square z9-lane schedule on promoted e876032, official 801,426,223, unpromoted -- the tree this candidate starts from)
note: Base tree: submission 21d37ea8 (commit ec2c9c0), official 801,426,223 verified candidates/s, unpromoted only because it did not clear the 100-bips floor over 797,446,582. Three independently switched additions, all value-exact: QSB_GT_L1PF=1 (prefetch.global.L1 of the next chunk's 64-byte table record, issued one addition ahead in the rolled fixed-base chain; no destination register, no value read), QSB_GT_CODE_AHEAD=1 (the arena digit-code read for chunk c+1 hoisted into iteration c; the arena is written once before the chain and each thread reads only its own column), and QSB_RAWS_FIN=1 (the two PARITY_SUM finish products stay raw, with the a[3]!=2^64-1 boundary retained, so raw+a<2p and the one conditional subtraction in _ModAdd256 still returns the canonical abscissa). Arithmetic and memory footprint are otherwise byte-identical to the base tree.
